High-pass filtering to reduce low-frequency keyboard vibrations

picker.note: Choose a project to cheer for. Its name will appear in the {provider} payment item.
picker.funding: Your choice expresses which project you are cheering for. Contributions support development and maintenance across all {brand} apps and projects.

items.question: Which projects does my contribution support?
items.answer: Choose a project to cheer for; its name is shown in the {provider} payment item. This is shared support for all {brand} apps and projects. Contributions help fund development, maintenance, testing, and running costs.

items.question: Will I be charged every month?
items.answer: No. This is a one-time contribution, not an automatically renewing subscription. Enter your preferred {currency} amount on {provider} and review it before paying.

items.question: Does contributing unlock features or priority support?
items.answer: No extra features or priority support are included. Your contribution is a voluntary way to support {brand}'s development and maintenance.

items.question: Will my name or payment details be published?
items.answer: This website does not publish supporter names or payment records. If we would like to include you in a future thank-you message, we will ask for your permission first.
